title: Sustained demand surge: top up the open PO
description: Agua Ciel 1L sales at Polanco ran ~60% above forecast on every one of the last 7 days, spread across many small orders, with no promotion running. The forecast has not caught up. The evidence supports a real shift, so the agent increases the open PO, which can still be changed.

trigger.message: Sales of the last 7 days are 60% above forecast.

rationale: baseline = mean of days -28..-8 (21 days) = 840/21 = 40.0; recent = mean of days -7..-1 = 448/7 = 64.0 (+60%)
a day is elevated if sales > baseline x 1.25 = 50: all 7 recent days are elevated (>= 5 of 7 -> sustained)
largest single order is 4 units on every day and no promotion is active -> not a bulk order, not a promo
classification SUSTAINED_SHIFT -> adopt the recent run-rate 64/day as the demand basis
on the stale forecast (40/day): net = 200 + 80 - 150 - 200 = -70 -> the old plan looks fine, which is the trap
on 64/day: horizon 5 (lead 2 + review 3), demand 320, safety stock 2 x 64 = 128, net = 320 + 128 - 150 - 200 = 98
PO-3001 (same supplier, arrives day 2 = lead time, not yet shipped) can absorb it: increase 200 -> 308 instead of a second delivery
projection at 64/day without change: d0 86, d1 22, d2 158, d3 94, d4 30 (below safety 128; day 5 would be -34)
